entries.title: Psalms 83:1
segments: ¶<<A Song [or] Psalm of Asaph.>> Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. {of Asaph: or, for Asaph}

entries.title: Psalms 83:2
segments: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

entries.title: Psalms 83:3
segments: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

entries.title: Psalms 83:4
segments: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from [being] a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

words.text: , and let us cut them off
may be no more in remembrance

entries.title: Psalms 83:5
segments: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee: {consent: Heb. heart}

entries.title: Psalms 83:6
segments: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

entries.title: Psalms 83:7
segments: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

entries.title: Psalms 83:8
segments: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah. {holpen: Heb. been an arm to}

entries.title: Psalms 83:9
segments: ¶Do unto them as [unto] the Midianites; as [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

entries.title: Psalms 83:10
segments: [Which] perished at Endor: they became [as] dung for the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 83:11
segments: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

entries.title: Psalms 83:12
segments: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

words.text: , Let us take to ourselves the houses

entries.title: Psalms 83:13
segments: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

entries.title: Psalms 83:14
segments: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

entries.title: Psalms 83:15
segments: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

entries.title: Psalms 83:16
segments: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 83:17
segments: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

words.text: ; yea, let them be put to shame

entries.title: Psalms 83:18
segments: That [men] may know that thou, whose name alone [is] JEHOVAH, [art] the most high over all the earth.
